description: This file contains unit tests for the silo role-based placement strategy in Orleans. It tests how grains are placed on silos based on assigned roles, including failure when the role doesn't exist and successful placement when it does.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirectorTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying silo role-based placement in Orleans, including cases where placement should fail or succeed based on silo roles.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CantFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that attempting to place a grain on a non-existent silo role results in an OrleansException.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CanFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that placing a grain on a silo with the correct role succeeds.
